records.title: HelixFold: An Efficient Implementation of AlphaFold2 using PaddlePaddle
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.05477. HelixFold optimizes AlphaFold2 protein-structure prediction, outside LLM inference scope.

records.title: Modality-Aware Neuron Pruning for Unlearning in Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.15910. MANU addresses multimodal-model unlearning and privacy, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Vision-centric Token Compression in Large Language Model
records.reason: Vist uses a vision encoder for distant text and is evaluated on its particular long-context/ICL design; text-only serving generalization needs validation.

records.title: WAGLE: Strategic Weight Attribution for Effective and Modular Unlearning in Large Language Models
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.17509. WAGLE improves selective data-unlearning effectiveness; abstract does not claim inference-cost/serving optimization.

records.title: A Quantum Circuit-Based Compression Perspective for Parameter-Efficient Learning
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.09846. Quantum parameter adaptation is for parameter-efficient fine-tuning; quantum machinery is confined to training.
